articles.title: New School Food Rules: What's Changing in Your Cafeteria?
articles.summary: The government wants schools to serve less processed food and more protein. But it costs more money, and some schools are worried.

articles.title: Poland's First Same-Sex Marriage Registered After Court Ruling
articles.summary: Warsaw registered its first same-sex marriage after EU courts said Poland must recognize marriages from other EU countries. The couple got married in Germany.

articles.title: Iraq Gets a New Prime Minister (But Only Half a Government)
articles.summary: Iraq's parliament approved a new prime minister, Ali al-Zaidi, but only 14 out of 23 ministers were approved. Key jobs like interior and defense are still empty.
